question: The best passive form of the sentence "I don't like idle people" is-
options: I am not liked by the idle people.
Idle People are not like me.
Idle people are not liked by me.
Idle people are not of my liking
correct_answer: Idle people are not liked by me.
explanation:
Active: 'I don't like idle people' (Present Indefinite Tense)।
Passive Voice-এর নিয়ম:
১. Object 'Idle people' Subject হবে।
২. Tense ও Plural অনুযায়ী 'are not' বসবে।
৩. মূল Verb-এর Past Participle 'liked' হবে।
৪. By + me বসবে।
সুতরাং শুদ্ধ রূপ: 'Idle people are not liked by me'.
hints: Passive: Idle people are not liked by me.
subject: English Language and Literature
exam: 11@Bangladesh Oil, Gas & Mineral Co - Asst. Manager (Admin) - 05.08.11
correctAnswer: Idle people are not liked by me.
